method: Median of all valid full-concurrency native rolling2s gauges; all C tasks must stream for the ENTIRE 2s window plus0.5s margin on each boundary. Per task is the median concurrent average (same-window total / C), not a cross-request distribution median. Excludes startup/prefill/tool gaps and completion tails; no speed threshold/cherry-picking.
pass_selection: Owner selected whole pass2; no per-cell run mixing.
